blind.description: A stylized, hand-painted wooden bookshelf featuring five tiers of shelves populated with colourful books (red, green, purple), parchment scrolls, a mug, and a potted succulent. Resting on the flat top ledge is an open book tented upside-down. The construction is solid dark brown timber standing on four corner foot extensions, with a small rectangular cutout/hole defect in the lower back panel.
blind.from_above: A wide rectangular wooden top ledge with molded corner overhangs, topped in the middle by an open book tented spine-up.
defects: rectangular missing-geometry hole on the lower back panel exposing books inside
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 ft tall (roughly 85% of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.8 ft wide
